events.what_it_is: TEMPTATIONS' first Cat Bodega, a free immersive Lower Manhattan pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats with cat-themed bodega environments, games and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission plus complimentary TEMPTATIONS Classic Treats and Lickable Puree to take home; claw-machine and scratch-off games offer chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: TEMPTATIONS and parent company Mars both confirm the three-day physical pop-up, daily hours, free admission/treats and address. Merchandise is prize-based rather than guaranteed to every visitor.
events.practical_notes: Thursday through Saturday, September 17–19, 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. No advance RSVP requirement is published by the brand.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown — The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th & W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown branded newsstand activation centered on Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with sampling, a mirrored photo moment and giveaway scratch-offs.
events.what_is_free: Visitors can receive a VEFB+ sample, grapefruit-infused Spindrift, a mini croissant and a scratch-off giveaway card; select scratch-off winners receive a full-size product.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC listings agree on the date, 12–6 PM hours, Chelsea Triangle location and free sampling. Full-size VEFB+ is limited to select scratch-off winners, not guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 12–6 PM at the Chelsea Triangle newsstand on 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets. No advance RSVP requirement is published.

events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas where eight chefs serve restaurant-style CookUnity meals and hot bites from neighborhood shop counters.
events.what_is_free: Anyone who walks into a participating location can receive a complimentary CookUnity signature dish while supplies last; guests also receive a bodega-style scratch-off for chances at additional prizes.
events.caveats: Current independent NYC coverage agrees on September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM and five Manhattan locations. Food is complimentary but availability is inherently limited during the three-hour giveaway window.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five Manhattan bodegas. Walk in; no advance RSVP requirement is published.

events.address: Robert F. Wagner Jr. Park, 20 Battery Pl, New York, NY 10280
events.what_it_is: Illumination NYC's fifth annual three-night waterfront light-art festival with 10+ installations, projection mapping, DJs, performances and interactive experiences.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the light installations, projection mapping, performances and public festival experience is free; food, drinks and merchandise are available separately.
events.caveats: Current event listings state the festival is free and open to the public for all three nights. Food trucks, alcoholic drinks and Light Shop merchandise are not represented as free.
events.practical_notes: Thursday through Saturday, September 17–19, 7–11 PM nightly at Wagner Park. No advance RSVP requirement is published.

events.address: Pier 17, 89 South St, New York, NY 10038
events.what_it_is: A Dunkin' Refresher Truck stop at Pier 17 serving drink samples and promotional swag to Seaport visitors.
events.what_is_free: Free samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher plus Dunkin' swag, all while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current event listing explicitly says the activation is open to the public and that drinks/swag are free while supplies last. An independent first-party Dunkin' event page was not recovered in this pass.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 18, 2:30–6 PM at Pier 17 in the Seaport. Walk-in public activation; supplies are limited.
